fact.en: Mahavira did not 'found' Jainism; he was the 24th Tirthankara, emphasizing established traditions.
fact.hi: Mahavira did not 'found' Jainism; he was the 24th Tirthankara, emphasizing established traditions.

fact.en: Jainism does not reject the existence of gods; it rejects the concept of a Creator God (Jainism is atheistic/non-theistic).
fact.hi: Jainism does not reject the existence of gods; it rejects the concept of a Creator God (Jainism is atheistic/non-theistic).

fact.en: Anekantavada (Non-absolutism) is often confused with Syadvada (theory of conditioned predication); Syadvada is the application of Anekantavada.
